evidence.description: The ISO8601DateFormatter is instantiated inside the lastUpdatedDate() function, which will be called for every result in the response, causing unnecessary allocations.

candidates.explanation: Instantiating a date formatter inside a frequently called method is a performance anti-pattern. Date formatters are expensive to initialize and should be reused or stored as a static property.
candidates.title: Inefficient DateFormatter Instantiation

evidence.description: The fetchAndUpdate method uses a switch statement to map results to individual properties, leading to repetitive logic for checking double values and dates.

candidates.explanation: The logic for updating properties like treesPlanted and totalInvestments is duplicated. This violates the DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) principle and makes the code harder to maintain.
candidates.title: Repetitive Logic in fetchAndUpdate

evidence.description: The statistics are updated using nil-coalescing to current values, but there is no validation to ensure the received value is actually different or newer than the current value.

candidates.explanation: The code blindly overwrites internal state with values from the network response without checking if the data is stale or if the value has actually changed, which can lead to unnecessary state updates.
candidates.title: Lack of State Validation
